title: Atlas record: shared facts plus per-artist judgment
description: A record is one label, distributor, collaborator, open stage, festival, showcase, booker, promoter or agent. `facts` is researched once per lane/city/country and cached; it must never contain an opinion about a particular artist. `judgment` is produced per artist profile and is the only part that changes between users.

org.description: Organisation when the record is a person (booker, agent)

who.description: Who runs it / key person, from a published source

lane_tags.description: Lane ids this record programs / signs / books

roster_trace.description: Named acts that evidence the lane (public roster, lineup, release history)

act_level.description: 0 closed / n.a. · 1 no open door · 2 submission form · 3 published contact

contact.description: Published business contact only. Never constructed.

cost_amount.description: Year-one cash cost or application fee in USD, when known

min_draw_band.description: Draw band realistically required to be considered (same scale as profile.standing.draw_band)

distance_minutes.description: Travel time from the run's anchor city (open stages, promoters, venues); filled by research

audience_band.description: Collabs: audience size band, same scale as profile.standing.listeners_band

rig_support.description: 0 no stage · 1 DJ only · 2 partial (tracks + mic) · 3 full (line-in, mic, DI)

verify.description: What was checked on official pages, what could not be, which fetches were blocked

fetch_blocked.description: Domains that could not be fetched unattended; route via a browser session next time

impact.description: How much this would move the artist if it happened

fit.description: How naturally the artist's sound and format sit in what this books / signs

likelihood.description: Odds of a positive outcome at the artist's current stage

why.description: One or two sentences, must cite the profile fields and facts it relies on

route.description: The concrete next step, or why there is none
